pairs.l: 1 — He has no interest in seeing her again.
2 — She doesn't feel like going to the movie.
3 — He'd like to hear more about her project.
4 — I don't know how you can still be interested in him.
5 — We're interested in getting to know her better.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (on ne nalazi je dovoljno zanimljivom) = E (She doesn't interest him). Poruka 2 (njoj se ne da gledati film) = F (She's not interested). Poruka 3 (on bi htio čuti više o njezinom projektu) = A (He is interested). Poruka 4 (on ih ne zanima više) = C (He doesn't interest them). Poruka 5 (zanimljiva nam je, hoćemo je bolje upoznati) = D (She's interesting).

r6.exp: Torba je bila £70, Julie ju je kupila za £20 manje → £70 − £20 = £50 (B).

r7.exp: Cathy plače cijelu noć i kaže 'I've never been so affected by written words' → dirnuta/ganuta = Moved (C).

r8.exp: John kaže 'My paycheck is great' → posao je dobro plaćen (B = well paid). Nije naporan niti motivirajući — zapravo mu nedostaje izazova.

r9.exp: Tina kaže 'I had to stop reading because I couldn't believe what the boys were doing' → šokantno (C = shocking).

r10.exp: 'You've always trusted your own skills' = uvijek je vjerovala u sebe → sigurna u sebe = Confident (A).

r11.exp: Naziv otoka koji se opisuje u tekstu je Kangaroo Island.

r12.exp: 'As the locals call the island' → lokalni naziv je Ki.

r13.exp: Matthew Flinders (britanski istraživač) je prvi sletio na otok 1800. godine.

r14.exp: 'The most massive is of course the famous grey kangaroo' → sivi klokan je najveća domaća životinja.

r15.exp: 'For those who are brave enough' → sandboarding je najrizičnija aktivnost.

r16.exp: 'Dolittle is an English gentleman who (16)____. He is a doctor of people who gradually withdraws from society.' → D: finds himself in the wrong occupation (u krivom zanimanju). Postaje životinjski liječnik.

r17.exp: 'Parrot tells him the secret (17)____. She helps Dolittle to understand the complaints of animals.' → F: that animals have a language of their own (da životinje imaju vlastiti jezik).

r18.exp: 'The author makes it (18)____.' → A: seem new and marvellous (čini se novim i divnim). 'Make it seem' je kauzativna konstrukcija.

r19.exp: 'Each species (19)____.' → C: has its own secret language (svaka vrsta ima vlastiti tajni jezik). 'Each species' je jednina.

r20.exp: 'Language of nature that (20)____. We only need to take the time and sympathy to understand it.' → B: is right there in front of us all (uvijek je tu pred nama).

r21.exp: 'The MOST important role models' — superlativ pridjeva 'important': the most important.

r22.exp: 'Making difficult decisions' — fiksna kolokacija: make a decision.

r23.exp: 'Serve AS a role model' = služiti kao uzor. Fiksna kolokacija: serve as.

r24.exp: 'HOWEVER' = međutim — diskurzivni veznik koji uvodi kontrast (pozitivni vs. negativni uzori).

r25.exp: 'THEIR hero's actions' = akcije njihovog heroja — posvojni oblik zamjenice (their).

r26.exp: 'IT takes just a blink of an eye' — bespersonalno 'it' kao formalni subjekt.

r27.exp: 'A FEW seconds' = nekoliko sekundi. 'A few' uz brojive imenice u množini.

r28.exp: 'The clothes you choose TO wear' — infinitiv nakon 'choose': choose to do something.

r29.exp: 'The trick IS (in) looking beyond fashionable clothes' — glagol 'be' ili prijedlog 'in' + gerund.

r30.exp: 'ON a daily basis' = na dnevnoj bazi. Fiksni izraz: on a ... basis.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) kako je prošao zadnji rođendan i što si radio/la, (2) čiji je poklon bio najbolji i zašto, (3) planovi za sljedeći rođendan. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi).
